answer: You rotated through four of them, always one at a time: Crunchyroll in January for anime, then MUBI in May once the anime phase ran its course and you wanted slow, quiet films, then Shudder in August when a friend pulled you into a horror phase, and finally Dropout in December for comedy and improv while folding laundry. Each one replaced the last rather than stacking on top of it, and Dropout is where you landed. Your partner's two-week burnout prediction back in January was wrong on timing but pretty much right about the pattern.
